name: @w6w-apps/hubstaff
description: Read the organizations, projects, members, teams, clients, tasks, activities and timesheets that make up a Hubstaff organization, and write back time entries and tasks.

w6w.longDescription:
Hubstaff is time tracking and workforce management: members track hours against projects and tasks, those hours roll up into timesheets, and organizations review, approve and invoice them.

This app covers the read surface a time-tracking integration needs — organizations, users, projects, members, teams, clients, tasks, activities and timesheets, each listed one cursor page at a time — and the three writes the API v2 actually offers for them: creating a manual time entry, creating a task, and moving a timesheet through its approval states.

Authentication is an Organization access token (hsoat_…), a long-lived org-wide secret an admin creates in the Hubstaff app and assigns to a member. There is no browser flow and no token exchange, so the whole credential story is one `Authorization: Bearer` header. Health checks cover Hubstaff's own status page (the API & Mobile component that speaks for api.hubstaff.com) and the organization's rate-limit headroom.
